cases.disposition_reason: TablePro with no --page flag opens Connections at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion. The landing screen shows Development and Filter connections, and Query 1 is absent. A click on Development shows host dev-db.internal.acme.io. Connect finishes on Query 1 with status Connected to Development after Loading schema has left the screen. Filter objects is present. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.entry_path: launch tablepro --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40 with no --page flag; click Development; Connect

cases.disposition_reason: On Development, the editor receives SELECT 't05_max_one' and Ctrl+T opens Query 2 with SELECT 't05_max_two'. Ctrl+B hides the explorer while the editor is capturing; both tab titles and the second statement stay. Ctrl+B shows the explorer and focuses it. [ and ] switch the two queries without inserting those letters. At 120 columns the query seam and the explorer seam are dragged. Hover paints the heavy rule without the accent, the held seam is the accent heavy rule, a neighbour rule stays thin, and release drops the accent. The pointer then leaves the seam and the thin rule returns. Esc leaves the editor and commits, so the SQL is unchanged. z maximizes the editor: both titles stay, the typed SQL stays, and Filter objects and No results yet leave. That frame is captured at 120×40 and at 80×24, with the narrow shot taken before the terminal returns to 120×40. z restores Filter objects, both titles, the same SQL, and No results yet. [ returns to Query 1 and starts editing; Esc commits. ] returns to Query 2; Esc commits. 0 focuses the explorer and does not insert 0. z then maximizes the results pane, hiding the SQL and the explorer while both titles and No results yet stay, and z restores the same layout. Ctrl+Q asks to quit because unsaved queries will be lost; Right then Enter confirms and the process exits 0.
cases.action_sequence: Hide and show the explorer. Maximize and restore the supported panes. Drag the implemented seams.
cases.expected_results: The restored layout shows the same tabs and SQL. Only the dragged seam changes style.
